title: [CON-17] `did:web` is treated as a user identity in §4.6, §9.1 and Appendix A; §2.1/§14.6.2 exclude
description: Review finding CON-17: `did:web` is treated as a user identity in §4.6, §9.1 and Appendix A; §2.1/§14.6.2 exclude it (lens CON). Location: spec/09-interop.md:24; spec/04-access-control.md:153; spec/99-appendices.md:11. Fix: Replace with `did:webvh` / `did:plc` / `did:key` (decision agora-did-methods). In 99:11, note that `did:web` is used for relay DIDs (10:110). Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
